Episode 165. After the Shock (7)
When Ronil seemed to be choosing his response, Octavia stepped forward. Her face was full of confidence, as if there was nothing to hide.
"I can't give you that, Jin Runcandel."
"I'm curious about the reason."
Jin glared at Octavia. She swallowed a sigh and shook her head once.
"That child is no longer the Veradin Zipfel you know. Now... he's almost like a newborn."
"A... newborn? It would be nice if you could explain in simpler terms, Spectre Captain."
"Literally. Currently, Veradin has lost all his knowledge, magic, habits, and... memories."
According to Octavia's expression, Veradin is now a blank slate.
Hearing this, Jin also felt his mind momentarily enveloped in a sensation of turning white.
Ronil furrowed his brow slightly as if uncomfortable.
Jin wanted to immediately subdue Octavia and hold a knife to her throat, wanting to tell her that if she doesn't explain everything about Veradin accurately from now on, he'll kill her.
Barely containing himself, Jin's gaze landed on Yuria.
Soon, the power of truth was manifested, and a blue thread appeared.
-"Until yesterday, I was in a state where I couldn't move inside the maintenance device. Well, thanks to that, the family won't be able to manipulate my mind for a while."
-"So now you seem to have lost all your magic."

-"Not just my magic, but there are some problems with my memory. I can hardly remember my siblings' names, and I've forgotten a lot of magic. It's a side effect of the rampage. The magic will definitely come back, but I can't be sure about the memories. As for magic, well, if I learn it again, that's it."
The conversation he had with Veradin before leaving for Lafrarosa.
At that time, even though Veradin had started to erase his memory, he hadn't forgotten a single thing about Jin and Dante.
After returning as a reward, Jin had heard from Kashmir that Veradin had not had any external activities, which made him feel anxious.
In the end, the anxiety became a reality, crushing Jin's heart.
Unconsciously, Jin looked at Sandra. It seemed that her being different from usual might be the result of an experiment like Veradin.
"So, you're saying he really can't remember anything?"
"...I know very well that Veradin is close with you and the Lord of Geomwhang. That's why I asked him a lot about you guys, hoping it might help. He couldn't recall anything at all."
For a while, Jin could not speak and trembled as he controlled his anger.
This is a conference room.
It's not a place gathered to resolve personal anger or resentment.
Moreover, Jin is the organizer of this conference and the representative of the Vamel alliance and its allies.
Octavia didn't underestimate such a Jin.
However, she thought that even with the power close to the strongest in the world, there were still some immature corners.
She also believed she had to end this before those aspects disappeared.
"Veradin is our charge, and he was the most prominent talent among the next generation of the family. It is more painful and sad for us that the child is ruined, not for you."
Jin had no idea how to deal with Veradin at the moment.
The thought of Valeria's record magic being helpful flitted across his mind, but it was just a hope.
"You dare to spout such words. You guys made Veradin like this. It must be the side effects of a living golem experiment. You guys experimented on a human to make him look like that."
"I don't deny it. But that doesn't mean I'm not suffering."
"So, what are you going to do with Veradin from now on?"
"I will find a way for the child to be normal somehow."
This time, too, a blue thread appeared.
For a while, Jin stared at the thread, then closed his eyes once.
"It seems hard even with your proud magic stone."
"From the beginning, the matter about the child is not your business. Anyway, for such reasons, I can't give you Veradin. Instead, Heddo Kyung here will help."

"He's said to be the strongest tower guardian in the Zipfel side, then let's send Zephyrin. Yeah, this much would ensure you won't die a pointless death even if Rosa Runcandel suddenly appears in the eastern 5 regions. It seems we've roughly sorted out this part."
The remaining items were the timing of the temporary alliance's total offensive against the Garden of Swords, the setting of the tactical situation, and the alternatives for unexpected situations.
Opinions started to come and go. From then on, Orgal took the lead in steering the meeting.
He had deeper and more extensive knowledge about the attribute of chaos, the recently known power, the evil god, and the prophet than anyone else.
"...So, since that day, Kinzelo has been continuously monitoring the formation of that ship called Ram."
In response to Jin's question, Orgal nodded.
"Yes. If my guess is correct, the current completion rate is less than 50%. Maybe not even 30%."
"Then we have to throw the deciding factor before it gets completed."
"We should hope that's possible. It seems hard at this pace."
"Ram... named after the last letter of his name? He seems to have strong self-love, the prophet... no, Heluram."
When Jin said that, Orgal let out a low laugh.
"It seems you thought the prophet was Heluram all along."
"I was suspecting that might be the case."
"Then your Jokokmyo didn't react to anything in the Garden of Swords, did it? The prophet is not Heluram, but her daughter. Just one of her many daughters..."
"Many daughters? Does that mean there could be more entities like the prophet in the world?"

"At least not in the human world. There could be some left in a space where Heluram has settled. But it's meaningless. They can never come to the human world before Heluram awakens. Anyway, her daughters only wish for one thing. The second coming of my former lover, Heluram."
"So, they use humans as sacrifices?"
"Not exactly humans per se. Of course, human flesh and bones are needed, but the efficiency is not that good. The real thing is despair. Only a large amount of pure despair can awaken Heluram."
"You seem to know a lot about Heluram. I'm starting to think you want to awaken Heluram."
"That's something only people who've never been in love would say. There's nothing good for me if Heluram awakens. I don't wish for that."
Although Yuria's power continues to form blue threads, Jin felt uncomfortable having to rely on Orgal's knowledge and experience in this way.
'I need to find Valeria and learn more about Heluram and the prophet somehow. Kwaol said the teacher talked about the beads he obtained from Joshua's villa before he left Tikan for the last time.'
The magic book of Suziel Hister.
Before leaving for Lafrarosa, Jin had entrusted half of Suziel Hister's magic book to Gilly.
Even though Valeria knew that the magic book was with Gilly, she didn't find it until about a year ago, and through it, she said she found clues to the record magic.
Thanks to that, she was able to accelerate the restoration of Joshua's beads and Solderet's recording device. Although she is missing now.

"Anyway, since there are no means to stop the formation of Ram at this point, we have to assume that the final battle will proceed with Ram completed. Our job is to send the 12 disciples against Ram and down to where Rosa is?"
At Ronil's words, Orgal nodded.
"Very precise. Let's hope that by then, Kelriac Zipfel will recover and the magic stone will reach its completion stage."
"12 disciples, I have a question."
"Speak, Ronil Zipfel."
"Do we have a way to purify chaos?"
Jin had deliberately placed the knights of the family, who were in the process of purification, in the route to the conference room.
Unlike other forces that utilize chaos control, it was to show that he has a perfect means of purification.
"Yes."
As the blue thread emerged, the pupils of Ronil and Octavia widened.
"In that case... Please use that purification method on my father."
"Didn't you say earlier that you couldn't inform me exactly about Kelriac Zipfel's condition?"
"It was because we needed to be careful."
"The purification method I possess is not perfect. If physical changes have occurred due to chaos, or if corrosion has completely finished, purification is impossible."
Once again, as the blue thread appeared, Ronil showed signs of being shaken for the first time.
"Given your reaction, it seems he's already in that state."
"I believe it's not just about the survival of the family, but a matter involving the fate of the world. Whether my father can fight in the final battle in his complete state or not."

"I will need Kelriac's power in the final battle. Of course, it's an unpleasant situation, but if the purifier improves before the final battle, and if we absolutely need the force named Kelriac Zipfel at that time, I'll use the purifier on him."
"...Understood."
Even after that, the meeting continued for more than two days, and the temporary alliance of the three forces caused a stir in the world from that day on.
March 7, 1803.
As he mentioned during the meeting, Jin was entering the Calderan snowfield.
This time, he didn't use the red owl. This was because Zephyrin, Hedo, and Sandra Zipfel were with him.
Fortunately.
Sandra was showing the same demeanor Jin knew, unlike during the meeting.

"Ahahaha, Mr. Jin! My acting was so convincing, right? How much I wanted to express my tremendous love for you during the meeting. But no, Sandra, get a grip! If not, I wouldn't have this opportunity to meet you alone like this! That's why I gritted my teeth and endured it!"
"...It was unplanned for me to say that I'll assign people to Zipfel and Kinzelo, wasn't it?"
"Only the prepared can seize opportunities. I acted crazy that day when nothing was confirmed, and as soon as the opportunity arrived, I could be with you like this."
Saying so, Sandra gave a broad smile and crossed her arms with Jin using her prosthetic arm.
Jin didn't immediately shake her off.
Because he felt relieved.
